info.name: CareCircle - Parent Profile
info.description: Per-parent profile endpoints for the profile switcher, backed by backend/app/api/families.py. GET needs dashboard.view; PATCH and DELETE need parent_profile.edit. Auth matches frontend/src/api.ts: 'Authorization: Bearer <session token>'. Bodies follow ProfileIn / ProfileOut in backend/app/schemas.py. Error bodies use FastAPI's {"detail": ...} shape.

request.description: Read the onboarding profile of the parent behind this care profile. Returns 200 with ProfileOut. If the parent has no linked account yet, returns an unsaved default profile. Returns 404 when the care profile is not in this family. Needs dashboard.view.

Save the fields sent for this parent (ProfileIn). Only fields present in the body are changed; section is required and must be one of parent, communication, care, medical, additional. Returns 200 with ProfileOut. Returns 409 when the parent has no linked account yet, and 404 when the care profile is not in this family. Needs parent_profile.edit.

response.name: 409 - no linked account
response.body: {"detail":"This parent has no linked account yet, so their profile cannot be saved."}

body.raw: {"section":"medical","calcium_deficiency":true,"calcium_deficiency_notes":"Low calcium on last blood test; takes supplements","sugar_problems":true,"sugar_problems_notes":"Type 2 diabetes, on metformin"}

request.description: Save the health deficiency answers for this parent (section medical). calcium_deficiency and sugar_problems are yes/no booleans (send null to clear); the *_notes fields are optional text up to 500 characters. Returns 200 with ProfileOut, which includes these four fields. Needs parent_profile.edit.

Delete only the onboarding profile of the parent behind this care profile. Returns 204 with no body, and still 204 if the parent has no saved profile. The care profile, family membership, medicines, appointments and other data are kept. Returns 409 when the parent has no linked account yet, and 404 when the care profile is not in this family. Needs parent_profile.edit.

response.name: 409 - no linked account
response.body: {"detail":"This parent has no linked account yet, so their profile cannot be deleted."}
